messages:
Marta: FYI Helion Labs flagged a Feb charge where dedicated burst appears duplicated in the invoice. They want a breakdown + provisional SLA credit. Anyone own meter logs?
Sam: Can you paste the invoice/line id? I'll pull the billing rows.
Marta: INV-2026-HELI-02 line 12 (reserved+d burst). Customer says same tokens billed twice, one to 'dedicated-pool-usw2' and one to 'dedicated-fallback-eu'.
metering-bot: Automated breakdown for INV-2026-HELI-02:
```
line_id,customer,model,region,pool,tokens
12,helion,redwood-7b,us-west-2,dedicated-pool-usw2,125412
13,helion,redwood-7b,us-west-2,dedicated-fallback-eu,125412
```
Sam: Huh — same token count + identical request IDs? can you grep the logs @Lee?
Lee: digging. Initial glance: routing bug in the cross-region fallback logic where a small fraction of requests were retried and metered twice when the model variant mapping changed during the rollout (tz: Feb 14 02:00–03:15 UTC).
Lee: sample of request routing lines:```
2026-02-14T02:12:03Z request-id=rid_9a1 pool=usw2 variant=redwood-7b vmap_version=98 status=200
2026-02-14T02:12:03Z request-id=rid_9a1 pool=euc1 variant=redwood-7b vmap_version=99 status=200 (retry)
```
Olivia: Customer escalated to AE. They're asking for timeline + numeric credit ASAP. Do we have a recommended approach? :pray:
Sam: Short term: compute duplicated token delta and propose a credit = duplicated_tokens * unit_price. We need unit price from the invoice lines.
Marta: Unit price for bursts on that invoice is $5.20 per 1k tokens (line metadata). Hold on any refunds until we confirm duplication across logs.
Lee: Confirmed duplicate request-ids = 42128 unique request-ids double-metered -> duplicated tokens = 42,128. I ran the join on request id in the metering DB.
Sam: OK math draft: 42,128 tokens = 42.128 k tokens. At $5.20 per 1k tokens -> credit = 42.128 * 5.20 = $219.86 (round to $220).
Marta: That seems right as a starting estimate. Can we also check whether any of those overlapped the customer's reserved commit allowance? If so, customer might've consumed commit tokens rather than bursts.
Lee: Checked committed window: those duplicates fell in a spike window where Helion's reserved commit was saturated; both meterings were recorded as burst (not reserved). So credit should be full refunded for duplicates.
Olivia: I'll let Helion know we're estimating $220 provisional credit pending final audit; ask if they'd accept a one-off goodwill credit while we finish audit.
Marta: Please also include apology and brief root cause (variant mapping + retry + TZ rollout). Include ETA for final audit (24 hours).
Sam: I'll prepare the credit memo and tag for sign-off. @Marta can you approve provisional amount?
Marta: Approved provisional $220 credit. Final will be adjusted if audit changes numbers.
Lee: Filing a postmortem and a quick metric alert to catch vmap_version drift during rollouts. Ticket LINK: https://redwood.internal/ticket/INC-5544
Olivia: Customer replied :thumbsup: and asked for the memo. Sam can you send the memo + adjusted invoice?
Sam: Will do. I'll mark it PENDING-CREDIT and attach logs + the computation.
Marta: Thanks all — please keep updates here.
notes: No title field included per agents.md rules; thread documents should be raw Slack content.
